ulasan.Ulasan: I’ve been a patient at this practice for over 5 years, and while the service has never been great, my most recent experience was absolutely unacceptable and will be the last straw for me. I went in while sick and struggling to breathe due to an asthma flare-up. I had just changed my insurance and provided the updated information to the front desk in advance.  Right before my appointment — while I was just 7 minutes away — I received a call saying they had lost my insurance details and needed them again. I told them I would bring the physical card when I arrived.  Once there, I was told by the office staff that they “didn’t have time to be calling insurances.” This was not only unprofessional but dangerous, considering I was visibly ill and having trouble breathing. I have PPO insurance through my employer, and when they claimed Blue Cross Blue Shield couldn’t find me, I personally called the insurance company, who confirmed my active coverage and offered to speak directly with the office. The office manager refused to take the call, saying she didn’t have time and that they’d need to send an email instead.  This kind of careless, dismissive attitude toward a sick patient is not just poor service — it’s negligent. I’ve tolerated the consistently rude and unhelpful behavior from this staff for years, but this experience crossed the line into outright abuse and disregard for patient health. I will never return, and I do not recommend this practice to anyone who values being treated with basic respect and care.

ulasan.Ulasan: Terrible Experience – Would Not Recommend  I had an appointment at this office on 09/26/24, and honestly, I’m baffled by the positive reviews. I’m starting to believe they either pay for reviews or have family members writing them, because my visit was far from the glowing feedback others have mentioned.  First off, the parking situation is a nightmare. Once I finally got inside, the lack of attention to cleanliness and privacy was concerning. Blood was drawn in an open area with people constantly walking by, and when I had to provide a urine sample, I was instructed to place it on a table out in the open. It felt unsanitary and extremely unprofessional.  The APRN was another disappointment. When I voiced concerns and asked questions about her suggestions, she became visibly annoyed and actually said, “What did you come for then?” It was incredibly rude and dismissive, leaving me feeling like my input didn’t matter at all.  To make matters worse, I had requested a telehealth appointment on 10/07/2024 between 2-3 PM to go over my blood results, but the doctor or office never called. When I contacted the office the next day to cancel any future appointments and to get a copy of my blood results, the staff member acted as if she took it personally. She claimed I never had an appointment on 10/07 and told me I’d have to get the results myself. This level of unprofessionalism is unbelievable.  Considering the poor cleanliness, lack of privacy, and dismissive staff, I have no idea how this office has so many good reviews. It certainly wasn’t up to par with other medical offices I’ve been to. I won’t be returning, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.  UPDATE: Thank you, Dr. Nova, for your spirited response. While I admire the passion you put into defending your practice, let’s clarify a few things for future readers who, like me, might not have the ‘glowing’ experience they’d expect. 1.	Paid Reviews?  My comment wasn’t to imply that every review was paid, but more of a reflection of how my experience felt… misplaced among the overwhelming positivity. If only my own visit had matched the enthusiasm of your ‘unpaid’ reviewers! 2.	Parking ‘Nightmare’: I appreciate your reminder that you don’t manage the parking lot; I wasn’t expecting valet service. However, parking was indeed a hassle on my visit, and though it might seem trivial, first impressions do matter, especially when you’re already braving a medical appointment. 3.	Cleanliness and Privacy Concerns: Eighteen years of passing inspections sounds impressive. However, on my particular day, it seemed like those high standards might have taken a coffee break. I can only comment on what I saw, and while architecture wasn’t my main concern, a little extra sparkle and privacy never hurt anyone. 4.	‘Rude’ ARNP: I didn’t realize I was expected to walk in with a blank slate! It seems odd that my respectful questions led to visible annoyance. Misogyny? A bit much. I came as a patient, hoping for a partner in my health journey, not a debate club. Being made to feel like an inconvenience wasn’t on my agenda for the day. 5.	Telehealth Mix-up: Ah, the mysterious vanishing appointment! It’s almost poetic. While I appreciate your offer to forward my results, a bit of transparency and support when I first called would have gone a long way. It’s not just about the mix-up; it’s about how I was treated when I sought clarification.  In any case, I’m glad you’re so dedicated to maintaining an image. My review stands as my honest experience, creative flair included. Best of luck, and I hope other patients find the five-star experience I seemed to miss.
